description: This file defines the IClusterMembershipService interface, outlining the contract for querying and managing cluster membership within the Orleans runtime. It includes properties and methods for retrieving snapshots, updates, refreshing membership information, and declaring silos defunct.

classes.name: IClusterMembershipService
classes.description: Interface providing cluster membership management functionalities such as retrieving current snapshot, watching membership updates, refreshing data, and declaring silos defunct.

methods.name: CurrentSnapshot
methods.description: Property that returns the most recent cluster membership snapshot.

methods.name: MembershipUpdates
methods.description: Property providing an asynchronous stream of membership update snapshots.

methods.name: Refresh
methods.description: Asynchronous method to refresh cluster membership info if it is outdated based on a minimum version.

methods.name: TryKill
methods.description: Asynchronous method to declare a given silo address as defunct, returning true if eviction was successful.
